title: Study: Younger Kids Feel More Excited About AI Stories
summary:
How do young people feel when they watch videos or stories made with artificial intelligence, or AI? A new study says it depends a lot on their age.

The study comes from UCLA and the Center for Scholars and Storytellers. It surveyed young people between the ages of 10 and 24 about movies, shows and storytelling.

Overall, 53.8 percent of them said AI content made them feel "fascinated" or "excited." Only 32.1 percent said they felt "doomed" or "scared."

But the feelings changed as the age groups got older. When asked to finish the sentence "Watching a story with AI in it makes me feel...," just 9.7 percent of 10- to 13-year-olds chose "doom." That rose to 25.1 percent for 14- to 18-year-olds and 27.4 percent for 18- to 24-year-olds. Nearly half of the 10- to 13-year-olds said they felt excitement.

The study says many of these feelings come from AI videos that young people see on social media, such as silly clips of talking fruit. It suggests there may be a generation gap between Gen Z and the younger Generation Alpha, who may view AI more positively.

One 13-year-old in the study said they wanted AI shown "in a balanced and realistic way," with both its benefits and risks, including AI helping people learn and solve problems.

The study, now in its fifth year, also looked at other topics. More than half of young people said seeing a movie in a theater would be their top weekend activity with friends. Many also preferred hopeful messages on screen, and most did not want social media influencers in their movies and shows.
why_it_matters: As AI-made videos become common, knowing how different ages feel about them can shape how stories, shows and lessons about AI are made for young people.

keywords.explanation: Artificial intelligence is computer technology that can do tasks that usually need human thinking, like writing or making pictures.
Surveyed means asked a group of people questions to learn what they think.
A generation gap is a difference in views or habits between people of different ages.
Influencers are people who have many followers on social media and can affect what others like or buy.
Fascinated means extremely interested in something.
